text.2:276: Allah hath blighted usury and made almsgiving fruitful. Allah loveth not the impious and guilty.
text.4:107: And plead not on behalf of (people) who deceive themselves. Lo! Allah loveth not one who is treacherous and sinful.
text.26:222: They descend on every sinful, false one.
text.68:12: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor
text.83:12: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,
